official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Turn an idea into a song. Describe a mood, a story or a style, or bring your own lyrics, and Suno makes two versions to choose from. Cover a song in a new style or voice, extend it, mash two songs together, split it into stems, or upload your own audio or MIDI to build on. Make cover art and video clips for a song, or a whole music video cut to the music. Signed in with your Suno account, everything lands in your suno.com library, where you can find and remix the songs already there, sort them into workspaces and playlists, and publish the ones you want to share.

summary_ja: 文章や歌詞から曲を作り、曲の編集・カバー画像や動画の制作を行う。
limitations_ja: Sunoアカウントでライブラリに保存。公開機能があるが今回操作していない。
